o1: Predicted to enable guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Enables Rho guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Involved in protein localization and embryonic cell polarity. Is located in cell cortex and nucleoplasm. Is expressed in hermaphrodite gonad; intestine; neurons; somatic gonad precursor; and vulva. Is part of the CDC-42 signaling pathway. Predicted to interact with CDC-42. Orthologous to human MCF2 (MCF.2 cell line derived transforming sequence); MCF2L (MCF.2 cell line derived transforming sequence like); and MCF2L2 (MCF.2 cell line derived transforming sequence-like 2).
